values.value: notBefore year=min(current year,2014); notAfter=generation +10 calendar years

values.name: host certificate serial
values.value: seed=epoch_millis as i32; serial=abs(previous counter), then wrapping increment; unsigned_abs emits MIN_VALUE as positive 2147483648 because rcgen cannot emit a negative serial

values.name: host certificate chain and usage
values.value: leaf+CA; primary host SAN first when absent, then supplied DNS SANs; serverAuth; critical digitalSignature
